instruction: Configure GIMP's single-window mode to display each open image as a tab.

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling tabs display in GIMP's single-window mode. The evaluator checks the sessionrc config file for the 'show-tabs' setting being set to 'yes'. Similar difficulty to original - requires accessing GIMP preferences (Edit > Preferences > Interface > Single-Window Mode) to enable tabs.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement: checks if tabs display is enabled in GIMP
Getter logic is correct: retrieves GIMP sessionrc config file where tab settings are stored
Metric logic is correct: parses sessionrc file (Lisp-style format) and checks for 'show-tabs yes' setting
Postconfig is appropriate: closes GIMP with Ctrl+Q to ensure settings are written to sessionrc before verification
Expected value is semantically correct: 'show-tabs' set to 'yes' is the exact setting that enables tabs display
Parameter handling is correct: metric function receives rules dict directly (as per framework design for type='rule')
Complete coverage: instruction has single requirement (enable tabs), evaluator checks exactly this
Data flow is sound: sessionrc file exists at ~/.config/GIMP/2.10/sessionrc on Linux, getter can access it, metric can parse it
